experiment: Lab experiment 2: fiscal sensitivity over time
label: Lab experiment
status: associations in model-estimated term premia; not causal; events are annotation, not tests
reporting_units: basis points of premium per 1 point of GDP of fiscal deterioration (bp = -100 x coefficient on the balance, surplus positive); positive = larger deficits go with a higher premium

coming_back_rule.text: The link counts as reappearing only if the latest filtered estimate's 95% interval lies entirely above the post-2008 range of the filtered path, that is, its lower bound is above the highest filtered point estimate from fiscal year 2009 to the year before the latest. Otherwise it does not count as reappearing, however much the line has risen.
